extracted.name: Margarita Grilled Shrimp
extracted.description: This margarita grilled shrimp recipe features a marinade of cilantro, lime, garlic, tequila, cayenne pepper, and olive oil for a full-flavored kick.
ingredient_lines: 4 bamboo skewers, soaked in water for 20 minutes
instruction_lines: Combine shrimp, oil, cilantro, lime juice, garlic, tequila, cayenne pepper, and salt in a large bowl. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap; refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil the grate.
Remove shrimp from marinade and shake off excess; discard remaining marinade. Thread shrimp onto the prepared skewers.
Cook on the preheated grill until shrimp turn pink, 2 to 3 minutes per side.
